description: Era railroad-label gazetteer for Chicago: normalize_rail_name output -> modern OSM name/operator groups (rail-chicago-cta-overpass.json or a corridor extract). rail_crossing_candidates pairs a printed label ONLY with its bound groups; a label absent from bindings is unbound and yields zero candidates. Hand-built by reading historic rasters (IDOT 1928 historic rail map, ICC valuation maps); 'unbound' entries are documentation only — the reason a label deliberately has no row.

binding_notes.NORTH SIDE MAIN LINE: CM&StP Evanston Division / Northwestern Elevated right-of-way is today's CTA North Side Main Line; carried by the citywide merged extract (rail-chicago-cta-overpass.json) and corridor extracts (tests/data/f5_rail.json). Bound only from corridor-naming rows (Evanston Div/Branch, Northwestern Elevated, Chicago & Evanston) — with CTA geometry live citywide, generic C.M.&ST.P. labels crossing the el bound ~400 m off that road's actual Kingsbury trackage, so the generic rows dropped this group (measured on _018 p17).
binding_notes.LOOP L / SOUTH SIDE ELEVATED / LAKE BRAN: CTA elevated alignments still on their original structures: Union Loop, South Side Elevated (Chicago & South Side Rapid Transit), Lake Street Elevated (Chicago & Oak Park), Evanston Branch (Chicago & Evanston). Adopted from a measured trial.
binding_notes.UP KENOSHA SUBDIVISION: C&NW Milwaukee Division (grade-separated 1900s-10s, hence the sheets' '(ELEVATED)') -> C&NW -> UP; Metra UP-N. Bare 'MILWAUKEE DIVISION' follows Sanborn's C&NW division style; CM&StP branches print as 'C.M.&ST.P.' with parentheticals.
binding_notes.C M SUBDIVISION / ELGIN SUBDIVISION: surviving Milwaukee Road main lines (Chicago & Milwaukee; West/Elgin) for a generic CM&StP label.
binding_notes.ELSDON SUBDIVISION: Chicago & Grand Trunk -> Grand Trunk Western -> CN Elsdon Sub.
binding_notes.JOLIET/BEVERLY/BLUE ISLAND SUB DISTRICT: CRI&P main + branches -> Metra Rock Island District.
binding_notes.BELT RAILWAY OF CHICAGO / IHB: belt lines still operating on their original alignments under their own names.

unbound.CHICAGO JUNCTION R Y: stockyards belt; trackage demolished with the Union Stock Yards — no modern successor geometry (measured 856-1205 m noise)
unbound.M C R R: Michigan Central's Chicago approach rode IC lakefront trackage — no distinct modern group
unbound.ERIE R R: entered Chicago on C&WI trackage rights — no distinct modern group
unbound.N Y C ST L R R: Nickel Plate; South Side approach absorbed/abandoned — no confident modern group
unbound.METROPOLITAN WEST SIDE ELEVATED R R: the Garfield Park main line was demolished for the Congress alignment; only the Paulina Connector and parts of the Douglas branch survive — binding needs per-branch raster verification, not initialism matching. Covers the whole ~50-label family of spelling variants (MET WEST SIDE ELEV RY, METROPOLITAN WESTSIDE EL RY, branch-qualified forms, ...).
unbound.METROPOLITAN WEST SIDE ELEVATED R R ELEC: see METROPOLITAN WEST SIDE ELEVATED R R
unbound.MET WEST SIDE ELEV RY: see METROPOLITAN WEST SIDE ELEVATED R R
unbound.METROPOLITAN WESTSIDE EL RY: see METROPOLITAN WEST SIDE ELEVATED R R
unbound.N W ELEV R R: ambiguous initialism: Northwestern Elevated (north side) vs the Metropolitan's Northwest branch (west side) — resolve per volume against the raster before adding rows (~40 labels incl. N W EL R R)
unbound.N W EL R R: see N W ELEV R R
